custodians.scope: Local cadastral custodian evidenced by first-party IGAC habilitation notice and municipal planning cadastral resolutions; current public parcel geometry access was not qualified.

custodians.name: Instituto Geográfico Agustín Codazzi (IGAC)
custodians.scope: National cadastral authority and official Colombia en Mapas/open-data publisher; not treated as proof of a working municipal parcel endpoint.

requests.outcome: Returned HTTP 200 service-folder metadata listing four public MapServer services, including Gestores_Catastrales.
Returned HTTP 200 metadata with layers Departamento and Municipio - Tipo prestación de servicio; full extent declared in EPSG:9377. This is a gestor-boundary service, not a parcel service.
Returned HTTP 200 layer metadata. Geometry is polygon; observed schema includes municipal/gestor fields and EPSG:9377. No parcel identity field was inferred.
Bounded request timed out after 20 seconds with no response body.
Host returned an Unauthorized Activity Detected HTML block; no feature or geometry was returned.

Official viewer HTML was reachable, but it reported that required components could not load in this fetched session. The page exposes cadastral consultation UI concepts but no usable anonymous parcel response was obtained.
First-party guidance was reachable and documents public cadastral consultation by map click, address, parcel number, or coordinates; no Barrancabermeja parcel response was produced in this attempt.

queryOutcomes: Separate English and Spanish first-party discovery queries were executed and recorded in city-4267-barrancabermeja.json. They identified the municipal cadastral custodian, official viewer, cadastral guidance, and IGAC REST catalog.

schemaAndCrs.note: EPSG:9377 was observed only on the gestor-boundary layer; no parcel-layer CRS was returned.
